prompt: Landscape 2:1. One hand-drawn curved arrow drawn in thick soft pink chalk pastel #f472a8 on paper: a grainy, powdery crayon texture with rough, slightly broken edges and visible tooth, one confident stroke of even weight, no outline, no fill, no shadow. Clear margins. Transparent background. Its tail starts at the lower left, the stroke rises in a low gentle arc and levels out, then finishes at the far right with a chunky open arrowhead pointing horizontally to the right, like →, not downward.
